title: gpbiometricspy: Python tools for Gazepoint biometric workflows
description: gpbiometricspy is the Python counterpart of gpbiometrics, with gpbiometrics 2.0.0 frozen as its initial semantic reference. It provides Gazepoint-native workflows for EDA/GSR/SCR, PPG/HRV, pupil, gaze, fixation, AOI, TTL/event alignment, multimodal quality control, analysis, plotting, reporting, simulation, reproducibility, and interoperability. The 0.1.4 development line preserves the complete 406-export scientific contract, retains 100% statement coverage, adds audited branch-path validation with zero unaudited branch debt, and continues to distribute gpbiometricspy Studio as a Shiny for Python application layer over the public scientific API.
